description: Nicolò Aicardi and coauthors publish a Dutch mainline railway instance and solvers for cascading causal failures. Zenodo lists a public replication archive under MIT. Its description specifies 2,401 nodes, 1,768 arcs, 805 causal rules and 40 monitored service pairs assembled from ProRail open data and an OVapi GTFS feed. The package contains C++ mixed-integer, column-generation, branch-cut-and-price and greedy methods, plus generators and raw result logs. This model can test route survivability and service connectivity in linked-disruption simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this causal-failure railway package. Coverage is a derived Dutch mainline instance, not real-time rail operations. A limitation is that rebuilding and running solvers requires IBM ILOG CPLEX 22.1.2, which is a separate dependency and may have licensing costs. Causal rules and route-length constraints are modelling choices. No archive was downloaded, no solver was run, and claimed optimality or recovery metrics were not independently verified.
